regions.name: The Sword Coast
regions.description: A rugged region of Northern Faerûn featuring majestic trade-cities, ancient ruins, and dense untamed wilderness.

regions.name: The Underdark
regions.description: A vast subterranean wonderland of hazard and mystery, lit by phosphorescent fungi and deep bioluminescence.

locations.name: City of Neverwinter
locations.description: A bustling metropolis rising from the ashes of destruction, now a major hub of civilizations.

cityBuildings.name: The Moonstone Mask Inn & Tavern
cityBuildings.description: Neverwinter's most famous roadhouse and tavern, floating above the harbor. Renowned for its masked clientele and spiced mulled wine.

interiorMaps.name: Moonstone Mask - Grand Taproom & Hearth
interiorMaps.description: The floating main lounge with mahogany tables, crystal chandeliers, and a lavish bar.

interiorMaps.name: Moonstone Mask - Second Floor Suites
interiorMaps.description: Private meeting rooms and guest chambers overlooking Neverwinter Bay.

cityBuildings.name: The Beached Leviathan Tavern
cityBuildings.description: A boisterous seaside tavern constructed from the hull of a stranded pirate galleon. Filled with sailors and treasure hunters.

interiorMaps.name: Beached Leviathan - Ship Deck Bar
interiorMaps.description: The weather-beaten wooden deck converted into a bustling taproom.

cityBuildings.name: Castle Never (Lord's Enclave)
cityBuildings.description: The grand fortress of Lord Protector Dagult Neverember, towering proudly over the city.

cityBuildings.name: Hall of Justice (Temple of Tyr)
cityBuildings.description: A colossal white marble temple dedicated to Tyr, God of Justice. Serves as city court and defensive redoubt.

cityBuildings.name: The Shining Serpent Curios & Alchemy
cityBuildings.description: An eccentric herbalist and potion shoppe run by a retired elven mage.

locations.name: Neverwinter Wood
locations.description: A dark, dense forest filled with fey beings, goblins, and ancient magical ruins.

locations.name: Cragmaw Castle
locations.description: A ruined stronghold claimed by the Cragmaw goblin tribe to ambush travelers along the Triboar trail.

locations.name: Phandalin Frontier Town
locations.description: A rough-and-tumble frontier town built on the ruins of a historic settlement. Safe haven for adventurers.

cityBuildings.name: Stonehill Inn & Tavern
cityBuildings.description: A comfortable, two-story stone-and-timber roadhouse. The hearth is warm, the ale is hearty, and adventurers gather here to trade rumors.

interiorMaps.name: Stonehill Inn - Main Taproom & Hearth
interiorMaps.description: The ground floor taproom of the Stonehill Inn. Sturdy oak tables, a crackling stone fireplace, and a lively bar.

interiorMaps.name: Stonehill Inn - Wine Cellar & Storeroom
interiorMaps.description: Underground cold storage for casks of Dwarven Stout and provisions.

cityBuildings.name: Townmaster's Hall
cityBuildings.description: A sturdy stone building with a small bell tower. Harbin Wester holds court here and posts bounties for goblin raiders.

cityBuildings.name: Barthen's Provisions
cityBuildings.description: The biggest general trading post in Phandalin, stocking adventuring gear, rations, and mining supplies.

cityBuildings.name: Sleeping Giant Taphouse
cityBuildings.description: A rundown, rowdy alehouse at the eastern end of town. Frequented by rough miners and Redbrand thugs.

cityBuildings.name: Tresendar Manor (Ruins)
cityBuildings.description: An abandoned manor perched on the eastern hillside. Ancient cellars are rumored to delve deep underground.

cityBuildings.name: Shrine of Luck (Tymora)
cityBuildings.description: Phandalin's only temple, constructed of stones taken from ancient ruins. Tended by Sister Garaele.

interiorMaps.name: Phandalin Frontier Town - Tactical Chamber
interiorMaps.description: Interior layout for Phandalin Frontier Town. Prepared for tactical party positioning and battle encounters.

locations.name: Wave Echo Cave
locations.description: The fabled lost mine of Phandelver, rich with magical ores and defended by the sinister Black Spider.

locations.name: Ruins of Conyberry
locations.description: A completely abandoned village reclaimed by overgrowth. Home to Agatha the banshee's grove.

locations.name: The High Road Coastline
locations.description: The coastal trading highway stretching south, with sea breezes and rocky cliffs prone to bandit raids.

locations.name: The Shadow Portal
locations.description: A glowing crevasse in Wave Echo Cave descending deep into the subterranean caverns.

locations.name: Gracklstagh (City of Blades)
locations.description: A massive subterranean city of the Duergar dwarfs, filled with smelting smoke and continuous anvil hammers.

locations.name: Sloobludop Outpost
locations.description: A kuo-toan settlement built on the edges of the Darklake, worshiping the bizarre water god Demogorgon.

locations.name: Shrine of the Lolth
locations.description: A hidden arachnid cathedral, pulsing with violet light, sacred to the Spider Queen.

locations.name: The Root-Cellar Barrow
locations.description:
Starter Training Dungeon. An overgrown root
labyrinth beneath the Giant World-Tree. Wiping here only
erases the last 6 hours, making it a popular tourist dive

notes.title: The Lost Mine Legend
notes.content: Ancestors of the Stoneforge clan spoke of Wave Echo Cave. It holds the Forge of Spells, a source of legendary magic tools. We must search for clues near Phandalin town.

notes.title: Redbrand Menace Info
notes.content: Townsfolk whisper that a gang known as the Redbrands is terrorizing Phandalin. Their leader goes by the name 'Glasstaff'. It's rumored their main lair is somewhere hidden under Tresendar Manor.
